variants.copy: Error Panel variants define local presentation only. Incident recovery, support handoff, and multi-step remediation belong to patterns.

states.copy: Error Panel states follow explicit precedence so status remains readable and auditable.

variant-state-behavior.copy: Variant controls presentation; state controls local behavior. Incident recovery, support handoff, and multi-step remediation belong to patterns.

full-width.copy: Error Panel may fill its parent when content remains readable and behavior stays local.

responsive-layout-patterns.copy: Use responsive density to preserve labels, state, and targets; do not add pattern orchestration to Error Panel.

viewport-organization.copy: Viewport rules decide density and placement while Error Panel remains a component.
